steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ and award the entire lot to one vendor.
Apply an RFQ template before adding the product.
Add the named product with quantity 10 while leaving its location unset.
Complete the pricing sheet prerequisites for publishing.
Add one available QA vendor participant.
